items.t: Oil sludge leading to engine failure
items.job: Replace engine with used or remanufactured 2.7L
items.note: Owners report about $4,200–$4,900 on average. Some swap in a 3.2L instead.

items.t: Internal water pump leaks coolant into the oil
items.job: Replace water pump (timing cover removal), often with timing chain parts
items.note: If coolant has already damaged the bearings, the engine may need replacing.

items.t: Timing chain stretch or breakage
items.job: Replace timing chain, guides and tensioners
items.note: Bent valves after a broken chain add cylinder head work.

items.t: Engine knocking and bearing failure
items.job: Replace engine with used or remanufactured unit
items.note: Owners report $3,000–$5,100 on average.

items.t: Automatic transmission slipping, harsh shifting or failure
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with remanufactured unit
items.note: Owners report about $2,150 on average. A solenoid or servo fix costs far less.

items.t: Steering rack and tie rod wear
items.job: Replace power steering rack and pinion, then align
items.note: Inner tie rods or rack bushings alone cost less.

items.t: Stalling or no-start from cam or crank sensor
items.job: Replace crankshaft or camshaft position sensor

items.t: Oil pressure light flickers at idle
items.job: Test oil pressure; replace oil pressure sender and change oil
items.note: If pressure is truly low, the engine needs deeper work.

items.t: Timing belt failure if replacement is overdue
items.job: Replace timing belt, tensioner and water pump
items.note: Valve damage after a snapped belt costs much more.

items.t: Coolant leak from heater tube O-ring
items.job: Replace front heater tube and O-ring

items.t: Overheating from worn water pump impeller
items.job: Replace water pump (usually with timing belt)

items.t: Power door locks stop working
items.job: Replace door lock actuator (one door)

items.t: A/C stops blowing cold
items.job: Replace A/C compressor, evacuate and recharge
items.note: A leak repair or condenser is often cheaper.

items.t: Door weatherstripping shrinks and falls off
items.job: Replace door weatherstrip seals

items.t: Cracked dashboard
items.job: Replace dashboard top pad
items.note: A molded dash cover costs well under $100.

items.t: Head gasket failure on older V6 engines
items.job: Replace head gaskets

items.t: Pinched rear defroster wire can cause a fire
items.job: Repair rear defroster wiring
items.note: Cost rises a lot if there is fire damage.

items.job: Recall repair at a Dodge dealer
items.note: Free under the recall if not already done. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.
